description:
The COALITION MIS is a titanium cervical ACDF cage and utilizes an integrated anchor fixation system allowing implantation of the spacer through smaller corridors.  The spacer can be used with the MIS anchor or traditional screw fixation.
This cage is available in 2 formats:
features: PEEK spacer with solid titanium plate
Titanium spacer with SintrOS which incorporated laser surfacet treatment technology which enhances bony ingrowth
